description: Mark an annotation done after applying the change. Always call this when you have made the change. `note` is REQUIRED and is not bookkeeping: the developer reads it in their browser as your reply to what they asked for, next to their original note. Say what you actually changed and where — e.g. "Made the field full-width below 640px in Hero.tsx:42 and added the hint text". "Done" or "Fixed" is not an answer. If you could not do it, say that here instead.

note.description: Your reply to the developer, shown in their browser: what changed and where, or why it could not be done

name: resolve_annotation
title: Resolve annotation
